text: The Goa State Commission for Women Act, 1996 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 199610 Act Number: 10 Enactment Date: 1996-07-31 Act Year: 1996 Short Title: The Goa State Commission for Women Act, 1996 Long Title: To provide for the constitution of the Goa State Commission for Women to exercise the powers conferred on, and to perform the functions assigned to it on all matters concerning women in Goa and incidental thereto so as to improve the status of women in Goa.
